name: arqdle
description: A Wordle-style daily guessing game about architecture.

scripts.build: npm run build:client && npm run build:server
scripts.build:server: esbuild server/src/index.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --outfile=dist/server/index.js --packages=external && esbuild server/src/migrate-cli.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --outfile=dist/server/migrate.js --packages=external && esbuild server/src/cleanup-guests.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --outfile=dist/server/cleanup-guests.js --packages=external && rm -rf dist/server/sql && cp -R server/sql dist/server/sql && mkdir -p dist/server/data && cp server/data/daily.json dist/server/data/daily.json
scripts.db:reset: docker compose down -v && docker compose up -d db

author: Felipe Lecot (https://www.felipelecot.com)
